Johnson Controls is a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency and decarbonization. We help our customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has been delivering performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turning goals into real-world results and helping move society forward.

Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information.

recentPosts.text: Cyber resilience starts by improving your system's visibility, reducing risk and prioritizing modernization. Our on-demand webinar gives you a strategy to do all three and secure your connected buildings. Get our experts' advice and move from awareness to action by watching it now: https://on.jci.com/4yyRsmR

As AI reshapes data center requirements, cooling decisions are increasingly connected to the broader design strategy.
Higher rack densities can affect everything from infrastructure planning to efficiency and long-term flexibility, making thermal management a key consideration in the design process.
Explore what this shift means for AI data centers: https://on.jci.com/4B9mMv3

Cybersecurity Awareness Month is a reminder: The air gap isn’t what it used to be.
Today’s connected buildings need a security approach that protects OT without sacrificing the connectivity that makes intelligent operations possible. Zero-trust security can help organizations move beyond assumed boundaries with identity-based access, microsegmentation and encryption.
👉 Learn why virtual air gaps alone aren’t enough:
https://on.jci.com/47p4j07

As AI workloads drive unprecedented rack densities, we’re helping operators reduce water consumption, control acoustic impact and improve cooling efficiency without compromising performance. At DCD Connect Virginia – a one-on-one learning opportunity for data center professionals – we’ll be there to show you how our chip-to-ambient thermal management can help your facility meet today’s challenges and prepare for tomorrow’s advances.
Learn more about the event here:https://on.jci.com/484aMxA

Data center demands continue to evolve and designing for flexibility has never been more essential.
The 1GW Reference Design Guides provide a framework for building scalable, adaptable infrastructure that can support changing workload requirements, evolving cooling strategies and future technology roadmaps.
Explore the guides: https://on.jci.com/3VJEntx
